brief.prompt:
INITIAL GENERATION PROMPT
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball thumbnail for バスケまとめ. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1536x864 or 1792x1008 PNG, width at least 1000 pixels. Opaque background.

Approved visual direction: near-black #151A18 background, vivid lime #CCF43B brush strokes and accents, off-white bold Japanese typography, expressive hand-drawn black ink and scratchy dry-brush illustration. A few large elements, strong visual hierarchy. Deliberately illustrated, never photorealistic, no photographic collage.

Layout: left 48 percent dedicated to clean text, right 52 percent to TWO real basketball players in a dynamic one-on-one matchup. The foreground guard Anthony Clemmons drives with an orange basketball in one hand, low athletic stance, body angled toward the viewer-left, face clear in three-quarter view. Behind and to his right Cameron Oliver is taller, defending with one arm raised and the other spread, face also clearly visible. Hands anatomically plausible, five fingers where visible, separate arms, no merging. Keep both heads and active hands inside frame; deliberate thigh crop at bottom is acceptable. Ball is a prop held or dribbled by Clemmons; no separate decorative balls. Plenty of breathing room around lettering. A diagonal lime ink sweep behind the players creates motion; sparse court-line suggestion only, no hoop, arena photo, crowd or extra people. Maintain ink-and-brush aesthetic with recognizable faces.

Real-person likeness observations from official 2026-27 team roster photographs:
- Anthony Clemmons, Koshigaya Alphas: dark brown skin, slim athletic guard build, close-to-scalp tight cornrow braids swept backward with clear straight partings, closely cut sides, long oval face, defined cheekbones, dark eyebrows, broad nose, full lips, neatly shaped medium full black beard and connected moustache. Draw him in a plain dark red basketball uniform with ivory edging; NO printed name, jersey number, team logo, manufacturer logo, sponsors, or emblems.
- Cameron Oliver, Fukuoka: brown skin, larger muscular frame, shoulder/neck-length black dreadlocks framing his face, a few brownish lighter lock tips, broad face, full black beard along jaw and under chin with connected moustache, broad nose, full lips, strong shoulders and tattooed arms represented by abstract ink texture rather than legible symbols. Draw him in a plain royal-blue basketball uniform; NO printed name, jersey number, team logo, manufacturer logo, sponsors, or emblems.
These are the ONLY depicted people. Do not substitute an invented athlete or copy the player in the style example. Reference photos establish appearance only: do not paste a photo or reproduce its pose.

Exact text, every item once only:
Small brand text at upper left: "バスケまとめ"
Small date/competition line below it: "11/27 ONE"
Very large left headline in two lines:
"2試合を"
"予測"
Use off-white for "2試合を" and vivid lime for "予測"; confident heavyweight Japanese gothic/brush type with clean, unambiguous glyphs.
A clear modest badge: "試合前予測"
Below headline, two concise lines, no score-like numbers:
"福岡 vs 越谷"
"横浜EX vs 岐阜"
Readable footer on quiet dark area, safely inset: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "イメージ"

Source semantics: this is a preview, not a game result. The frozen article covers two games on November 27: Fukuoka vs Koshigaya and Yokohama EX vs Gifu. The picture is a conceptual imagined play scene and makes no claim that this action actually happened or that these players appeared. Both players are illustrative selections from players named in the source's main matchup. Do not print player names, player statistics, scores, win claims, appearance claims, performance claims, or specific decisive play descriptions. No additional words or numbers. No official league or team logos. Keep all letterforms and AI disclosure readable. Generate the complete final artwork with text directly in the image.

ONE ALLOWED CORRECTION PROMPT
Edit the supplied basketball thumbnail with ONE targeted correction: fix the framing of the two illustrated players so ALL hands, fingertips, heads and the orange basketball are completely inside the canvas with clear breathing room. Currently the raised defender hand is cut off at the top and the driving player's low outstretched fingers are cut off at the bottom. Scale the entire TWO-player-plus-ball illustration down by approximately 12 percent, positioned within the right portion of the same composition. Keep at least 35 pixels of dark or lime background around the highest raised fingertips and lowest outstretched fingertips. Keep both faces large enough and recognizable. Thigh crops at the bottom are okay; do NOT crop any head, hand, finger or ball. Keep the players' anatomy coherent with exactly two arms and hands each. Maintain the same real players and facial identity: Anthony Clemmons in unmarked burgundy with tight backward cornrows and shaped black beard, Cameron Oliver in unmarked royal blue with loose neck-length dreadlocks and full beard. Do not introduce any new player or any name or number on uniforms.
EVERYTHING ELSE MUST STAY: exact current Japanese typography and text, same text placement and hierarchy, same black #151A18 and lime #CCF43B brush artwork and hand-drawn ink style, same wide 16:9 format and resolution, same conceptual one-on-one scene. Do not change, add, delete or misspell ANY text. Exact retained text: バスケまとめ / 11/27 ONE / 2試合を / 予測 / 試合前予測 / 福岡 vs 越谷 / 横浜EX vs 岐阜 / イラスト（AI生成） / イメージ. Keep all text readable and fully inside the frame. No logos, no photographic elements.
